competences: The learner names key offices related to departments in the district — part b.
The learner identifies how district officers provide services.
languageCompetence: Read, write and pronounce department, civic, district, veterinary, forestry, agriculture and administration.
objectives: By the end of the period learners should identify four district departments and their purposes.
By the end of the period learners should answer the original questions about district officers.
priorKnowledge: Learners studied the departments and some duties of district civil servants in the previous period.
materials: P4 Social Studies district leadership notes
references: Primary 4 Social Studies Notes for Terms 1–3

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher recalls previous lessons about district leadership and asks "5. Name the district officials who are in charge of the following;". They introduce departments in the district — part b and relate the question to duties in the district.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall district officials they have studied, respond to the opening question and name the public services they know.

steps.content: The district health department supervises medical workers. The education department oversees school programmes. The veterinary department helps livestock farmers. The agricultural department assists crop farmers. The forestry department conserves forest resources. The fisheries department monitors fishing activities. The district water office supports clean-water supply. The district police protect law and order. The district engineer works on roads and bridges. The finance office manages expenditure of public funds.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes sourced facts about remember, beginning with "The district health department supervises medical workers. The education department oversees school programmes." They use the original question "3. What title is given to the political head of a village?" to check knowledge and correct unclear answers.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners name district departments, explain the listed duties, answer the teacher's question and copy accurate notes into their books.

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher sets the original questions "5. Name the district officials who are in charge of the following;" and "3. What title is given to the political head of a village?" for independent work. They check written responses with the available reference material and provide corrections.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer the sourced questions independently, compare answers with their written notes and correct inaccurate responses.

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher reviews the important departments and roles, asking "10. What title is given to the head of the municipality?" and "11. State any one role played by the district speaker.". They mark any unfinished answers and assign the last question as homework.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify the relevant officers, answer oral review questions and write the final question for homework.

assessment: Check answers to "5. Name the district officials who are in charge of the following;", "3. What title is given to the political head of a village?", and "10. What title is given to the head of the municipality?". Mark work and correct using the district source notes.
